parameters.name: GrantOption
parameters.description: Specifies whether to grant the permissions with the GRANT option. Valid values: -**true** -**false**

parameters.name: NamespaceSource
parameters.description: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 grant-permission --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffcdf01 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id test.defaultGroup --user-id 277641081920123456 --user-name lilei --grant-option false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun schedulerx2 GrantPermission --region cn-hangzhou --GrantOption false --UserName lilei --UserId 277641081920123456 --NamespaceSource schedulerx --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Namespace 'adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffcdf01' --GroupId 'test.defaultGroup'
